supervisor.title: Find the OpenCode app
supervisor.description: Enable Assist in the OpenCode Beta app and restart the app. Restart Home Assistant Core after installing or updating the companion. Select the discovered app; connection details and credentials are exchanged automatically.

choose_entity.title: Set up OpenCode Assist
choose_entity.description: You can add both a conversation agent and an AI data task, one at a time. Choose which to add first.

menu_option_descriptions.conversation: Voice or text conversations through Assist, with optional Home Assistant control.
menu_option_descriptions.ai_task_data: Generate text or structured data for automations and scripts, such as summaries or classifications.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect OpenCode Assist
hassio_confirm.description: Confirm to pair with this app automatically. No URL or key needs copying. Provider charges may apply. Next, choose a model and, for conversations, the Home Assistant APIs to allow; no APIs are selected automatically. For an existing connection, confirming renews its pairing key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the app. Check that Assist is enabled and the app is running, then retry.
error.no_models: No text-capable models are available in the app's managed OpenCode workspace. Connect a provider and enable a model in OpenCode, then retry.
error.supervisor_unavailable: Supervisor discovery is temporarily unavailable. Retry when Supervisor is ready.
error.no_apps: No ready OpenCode Assist app was found. Enable Assist, check its installation log, and retry after the app starts.
error.discovery_expired: The automatic pairing request expired. Submit again to fetch fresh discovery information.

abort.no_apps: The OpenCode app is not ready for automatic onboarding. Check its Assist option and installation log.
abort.legacy_pairing: Remove this old manually paired integration entry, then configure the discovered OpenCode app.

user.title: Add a conversation agent
user.description: Select only the Home Assistant APIs this agent needs. No APIs are selected by default. Assist respects HA exposure and caller context.

error.unsupported_model: Choose a model with tool support when selecting APIs.
error.unknown_api: A selected API is no longer registered.

user.title: Add an AI data task
user.description: Generate text or schema-validated JSON. Attachments and image generation are not supported.

error.unknown_api: A selected API is no longer registered.
